headlines.title: Netflix hires Darshan Kantak to lead ads platform
headlines.summary: Netflix on Monday announced that former Google executive Darshan Kantak is joining the company as vice president of its ads platform.

headlines.title: Netflix cuts UK staff and parts with production head Anna Mallett, report says
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Netflix Inc (NASDAQ:NFLX) is cutting roughly 2% to 3% of its workforce at its London hub, parting ways with regional production chief Anna Mallett as part of a wider restructuring drive, according to reporting from Deadline. The regional retrenchment follows the streaming giant’s announcement two weeks ago to eliminate about 1,000 roles worldwide, or approximately 6% of its global employee base.

headlines.title: Prediction: Netflix Will Begin Paying a Dividend in 2027 and Beat the S&P 500 During the Next Decade
headlines.summary: Netflix's high-margin business model and slowing growth rate set the stage for the introduction of a dividend program.

headlines.title: A Cinema Chain Is Trying Something Strange to Bring Back the First-Viewing Feeling
headlines.summary: A Dutch cinema chain will hypnotize 30 fans so they forget a favorite film, as Netflix now earns over twice the US and Canada box office.

headlines.title: How Investors May Respond To Netflix (NFLX) Lower Ad Revenue Guidance
headlines.summary: Netflix reported third quarter 2026 results with US$12,874.18m in sales and US$3,663.93m in net income, and issued fourth quarter guidance that includes US$13,442m in projected revenue, a 26.0% operating margin and US$0.67 in expected diluted EPS. The company trimmed its 2026 ad revenue forecast to about US$2.7b and flagged softer engagement, even as it guides to a higher full year operating margin of 31.5% and implies operating income growth of above 20%.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
